import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    w = params[0]
    c = np.cos(w*t); s = np.sin(w*t)
    return (params[1]*c + params[2]*s + params[3]*np.log(v)*t + params[4]*np.sqrt(v)*c
            + params[5]*np.log(v)*s + params[6]*v + params[7]*v*np.abs(v) + params[8] + params[9]*x*c)
